summary: Iteration 8: tested field-level errors end to end (backend and UI). Backend: the new test_iteration8_field_errors.py passes 18 of 20 tests. The 2 failures are cosmetic: the message reads 'Deve essere maggiore di 0.0' instead of '... di 0'. All 40 iteration 6 and 7 regression tests pass after their detail assertions were updated to the array format. UI: 6 of the 7 requested scenarios show the red border, the field-error-* text and the toast. These are PA codice of 3 characters, quantity 0, duplicate number, missing client, CIG without a reference number and duplicate article code. Also verified: Settings with several errors, data not coherent, cassa aliquota 0, duplicate P.IVA in CompanyDialog, duplicate email in UserDialog and register. Scenario 7 (register with a short password) does NOT show the app's red field: native browser validation (minLength=8) blocks the submit with an English tooltip. The toast for several errors joins the messages with ' · ' instead of showing 'Correggi i N campi evidenziati in rosso'. Normal saves still work for party, invoice, article and settings.

minor.issue: Float bounds are rendered as floats: 'Deve essere maggiore di 0.0' (line quantita, cassa.aliquota), 'Deve essere al massimo 100.0'. The spec expects 'Deve essere maggiore di 0'. Fix: format ctx gt/ge/le with a :g format, or int() when the value is whole.

Type 'float_type' (null sent for a number field, e.g. quantita: null) is not translated and returns the English 'Input should be a valid number'. 'int_type' and 'bool_type' are not translated either. The UI normally sends Number(), so the impact is low.

ui_bugs.issue: The password Input has minLength={8} and required, so the browser blocks the submit with a native English tooltip ('Please lengthen this text to 8 characters...'). The backend 422 is never reached, so field-error-password and the red border never appear. Scenario 7 is not met. Fix: add noValidate to the form, or drop minLength and rely on the backend 'Minimo 8 caratteri'.

When there are several field errors, the toast shows errMsg joined with ' · ' (e.g. 'La Partita IVA deve avere 11 cifre · Il CAP deve avere 5 cifre'). The requested 'Correggi i N campi evidenziati in rosso' is not implemented: that string does not exist in the codebase.
The red state on line inputs (field-invalid-el) is NOT removed when the user types. useInvalid has no clear(), so line-quantita-0 stays red until the next save.

field-error-party-id and the red border remain after a client is selected; they clear only on the next save. selectClient should call clear('party_id'). Selects inside Field (rif_tipo, cassa.tipo, natura_default, etc.) have the same limitation, because a Radix select does not fire onInput.
Line errors show no inline text, and the toast has no context ('Deve essere maggiore di 0.0' without saying which line or field). Consider prefixing 'Riga N · Quantità:'.

action_items: Add noValidate to the EmailAuthForm form (or remove minLength/type=email native checks) so the backend field errors show with the red border
Implement the multi-error toast 'Correggi i N campi evidenziati in rosso' in useFieldErrors.fail when errFields size > 1
Format numeric ctx in _it_msg without a trailing .0, and translate float_type/int_type/bool_type
Clear line field errors on change (expose clear from ErrCtx in useInvalid) and clear party_id on client selection
critical_code_review_comments: Business errors are checked only after pydantic validation passes, so a form with both quantity 0 and no client needs two save rounds to show both errors. This is acceptable, but worth noting.
server.py is 1213 lines (over 700) and should be split into routers (auth, companies, parties, articles, invoices).

Some HTTPException errors are still plain strings without a field (sezionale change, 'Puoi stornare solo fatture già inviate', 'Una o più aziende non esistono', 409 'Numero già usato' on a DuplicateKeyError race). The last two could map to company_ids and numero.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (6/7 scenarios + all forms; register short password not shown by the app)
